ack.label: Thick-skinned
ack.description: Lower chance of being scratched or bitten.

ack.label: Fast Healer
ack.description: Recovers quickly from injuries and illness.

ack.label: Overly Lean
ack.description: Starts underfed: lean, with less body fat than the body is used to and no muscle lost. Hungry until the fat is regained. While it lasts: lower endurance and more prone to injury.

ack.label: Gaunt
ack.description: Starts underfed: very lean, with much less body fat than the body is used to and no muscle lost. Hungrier until the fat is regained. While it lasts: lower endurance and more prone to injury.

ack.label: Overfat
ack.description: Starts carrying more body fat. Fat is lost or gained by eating. While it lasts: slower running, lower endurance and more prone to injury.

ack.label: Very High Weight
ack.description: Starts carrying more body fat. Fat is lost or gained by eating. While it lasts: slower running, lower endurance and more prone to injury.
